hook: You're spending the first three days of every month copying numbers from three different spreadsheets into one master report.
caption:
You're spending the first three days of every month copying numbers from three different spreadsheets into one master report.

It is a familiar routine for many operations and finance managers: downloading CSV files, manually cross-checking figures, and fixing broken formulas right before your executive review.

When reporting relies on manual data entry, two main issues arise:
• Valuable time is lost on admin work instead of high-level analysis.
• Errors sneak in whenever data is moved by hand between disconnected tools.

A practical place to start is centralising your data sources. For example, connecting your CRM (your customer database) directly to Lark Base (a smart shared database) or your reporting dashboard. When software tools talk to each other automatically, month-end reporting changes from a multi-day ordeal into a quick review of accurate data.

Less manual data entry means faster decisions and more time for strategic growth.
